title: SunPower Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: SunPower Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing the entry into note purchase agreements for a $41,000,000 private offering of 10% Convertible Senior Secured Notes due 2029. Proceeds will be used to prepay existing debt, pay settlement amounts, and fund working capital.
key_points: SunPower Inc. entered into note purchase agreements for a $41,000,000 private offering of 10% convertible notes due 2029
$25,000,000 principal amount sold to qualified institutional buyers; $6,000,000 to CEO Thurman Rodgers; $10,000,000 issued in exchange for a seller note
Use of proceeds includes: $5,000,000 prepayment of YA II debenture, $4,750,000 Siemens settlement, $4,000,000 cash to CPP, $1,500,000 fees
Notes carry a 10.00% annual interest rate payable quarterly, with an initial conversion rate of 610.3143 shares per $1,000 principal
Initial conversion price is approximately $1.64 per share of common stock
Net proceeds after payments are expected to be approximately $9,750,000
